code_droits_reels.title: Code des droits réels
code_droits_reels.publisher: Imprimerie Officielle de la République Tunisienne, édition 2011 (copie compilée par Droit-Afrique, hébergée par bna.tn)
code_droits_reels.edition_note: Text as of the 2011 edition; later amendments are not included.
code_droits_reels.verification: Official copy unreachable (justice.gov.tn id 294 redirects to formation.e-justice.tn, which does not resolve). Cross-checked word by word against the JORT texts of the amending laws on FAOLEX: law 2001-35 (faolex tun25583: art. 316, 354, 358, 374, 375) and law 2010-34 (faolex tun97218: art. 381, 384, 377 ter point 5, 394 al. 1, 380 al. 4). No substantive difference; only scan errors in the 2001 JORT scan and page numbers. Annexes (other laws appended to the edition) were not verified and are not indexed.
